Name: Biggering Fishes - Big Fish Getting the Size they Deserve
Author: OrcaBaryonyx
Description:
[size=3][quote]﻿﻿﻿We're gonna need a bigger boat.

-Me[/quote][/size]

Stardew Valley is a great game, with a wonderful modding community, but the aquarium fish always bothered me. They're small, scrunched, not very well drawn, and instead of being animated, they shimmy around. I don't blame ConcernedApe for not taking the time to animate them all, as I am simply too hyper-fixated on this and its only an issue that the likes of I would care to solve. 

[size=6]So! Big Fish! <><[/size]
[size=3] [/size]
With the help of [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato?gameId=1303]mushymato[/url]'s framework, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42603]Moby Dick[/url], fish can finally be given the size they deserve.
[b]Biggering Fishes[/b] is a mod that goes through 9 of the vanilla fish and 5 fish [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], resizing and reanimating them to represent their real world counterparts much more faithfully, all while maintaining a relatively vanilla+ art style!
The mod also includes some ﻿optional config settings and changes as well.

Oh yeah, this is for Modfest 2026! [color=#6aa84f]Go Team Bog[/color]!!

[u]﻿What Fish are Changed?[/u]
[quote]﻿Aye, the fish seem a bit bigger this time o' year, don't they?

- Willy[/quote]

So far, out of the vanilla fish, I have modified:

[list]
[*][color=#a4c2f4]Tuna[/color]
[*][color=#dd7e6b]Catfish[/color]
[*][color=#b6d7a8]Pike[/color]
[*][color=#e69138]Dorado[/color]
[*][color=#cccccc]Halibut[/color]
[*][color=#9fc5e8]Lingcod[/color]
[*][color=#a2c4c9]Sturgeon[/color]
[*][color=#6fa8dc]Albacore[/color]
[*][color=#b45f06]Octopus[/color]
[/list]
And for Stardew Valley Expanded:

[list]
[*][color=#f6b26b]Gar[/color]
[*][color=#cc4125]King Salmon[/color]
[*][color=#6aa84f]Alligator[/color]
[*][color=#3d85c6]Ocean Sunfish[/color]
[*]Shark
[/list]
With potentially more in the future! (I am simply very busy...)

[img]https://i.ibb.co/pN9bpGy/Screenshot-2026-03-18-012117.png[/img]﻿
[u][size=5][b]What else does this mod change?[/b][/size][/u]
[quote]Why are you quoting me.

- Ikarus[/quote][size=4]
[/size]Right now? Not a whole lot. But there are some additional options available to you, should you choose.
Those are:
[list]
[*][u][b]Lingcod & Tilapia Swap:[/b] [/u]This config option changes a lot about Tilapia and Lingcod, mostly by swapping where each is caught. In this case, Tilapia is now caught in rivers and lakes, while the Lingcod is caught in the ocean. This is more true to real life, and I'm not sure why this is the case in Stardew. This also switches out Tilapia in the ocean bundle for Lingcod, and Lingcod can now be caught in fall as well, to help assist with that.[u][color=#ff0000] [/color][b][color=#ff0000]WARNING[/color]:[/b][/u] This config is set to [b]TRUE[/b] by default, because I'm petty. And the bundles will not be able to change naturally with the config changed mid-game. If you start a save with this setting on, the bundle will remain that way permanently. 
[*][u][b]Optional [color=#f1c232]Recolors[/color]:[/b][/u] This is a silly little option thrown in at the end. It recolors only a handful of fish with some alternate recolors done by me. These may become separate config settings if I make more in the future. This config is set to[b] false[/b] by default.
[/list]
I may add more options, depending on feedback to the mod.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/1tfwzCLG/Screenshot-2026-03-18-010001.png[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/YTJdRH10/Screenshot-2026-03-18-010123.png[/img]
[size=1]yes the image size bugs me too, dw[/size]


[b]﻿[u][size=5]What are my plans for this mod?
[/size][/u][/b]idk

I have several other mod projects in the way, so continuing this one isn't my top priority, as proud of it as I am. Though should I continue it, I would likely give the legendary fish some love, as well as reanimating the rest of the vanilla roster, before possibly reaching out to other mod creators for permission to modify their fish with this framework. I'm open to suggestions, but don't expect me to follow every single one. Things are subject to change and things will likely get reanimated (looking at you, shark...).

But like I said... I have other things planned...

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/t9mzxzX/calcetus.gif[/img]
[b]﻿[u][size=5]F.A.Q
[/size][/u][/b]
Just some questions to get out of the way before you ask them.

[list]
[*]Q: Is SVE required?
[*]A: No, it's optional, but includes support for it. The only requirements are [u]SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Moby Dick.[/u]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Q: What are good mods to use with this?
[*]A: I can recommend a few actually:
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]: For more fish options, some with Biggering Fishes support.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36938]Modular Fish Tanks[/url]: Another mushymato mod, great for more tank space and variety.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url]: Makes catchable fish visible in respective waterways.
[*]None of which are required, but are recommended for a better, fishier experience.﻿
[/list][list]
[*]Q: Can you add support for the fish in ____ mod?
[*]A: Idk, maybe. I will only do so if I get permission. And if I even want to.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Q: Will you be adding new fish?
[*]A: No, this mod is solely for enlarging pre-existing fish from vanilla or other mods. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Q: Will this mod work with ____ mod?
[*]A: Theoretically, this mod shouldn't conflict with much, though if you have texture replacement mods for fish items or aquarium fish, these will likely conflict. No surprise there. As for expansion mods, the only ones with manual support are SVE and East Scarp with some fishing location changes.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Q: Can I use your assets in my mod?
[*]A: [u]No[/u], at least, [u]not without my explicit permission[/u] for you to do so. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Q: Can I make an expansion to this for my own mod or another mod myself?
[*]A: If you ask permission from me first, most likely. But as a reminder, you can just use the Moby Dick framework yourself to make your own enlarged fish. This is simply my pack for doing so. Go support mushymato's mods!
[/list]
I'm sure this section will expand.
